rows.name: Clear a certain quest added to the main game to obtain the “Ether Jet,” a vehicle that lets you move around the field at a comfortable speed!
Can't find the quest!? Try looking around Evac Ship Camp!
After obtaining the “Ether Jet,” you can take part in minigames such as Score Attack and Battle Race! Tour each course and get new equipment!
New courses will be added as you progress through the main story!
New exclusive equipment has been added for Xenoblade's main characters! Travel the world of Xenoblade with a fresh new look!
Equip a full set from the same series and the Ether Jet enters Full Power Mode!?
Important events in the main game and “Future Connected” now support controller vibration! All Bonding Talks are also fully voiced! Experience the world of Xenoblade anew!
Event scenes also support high image quality and high frame rates!
Touch amiibo each day to receive bonuses such as experience points and items! You can receive amiibo bonuses from up to three figures per day!
Something good might happen if you scan the Shulk, Pyra, Mythra, Noah, or Mio amiibo?

High resolution and high frame rates supported
Controller vibration added to important events
Ether Jet added as a means of transportation
New equipment and minigames added
Details on each added feature can be viewed under “Added Content” in the System Menu!
